## Acceptance criteria

## Verification

Describe tests and checks actually run, their results, and any limitations. For documentation-only changes, describe document and link verification; identify inapplicable runtime checks.

## Review checklist

- [ ] Accepted ADRs and normative contracts are followed; changes to decisions are explicit.
- [ ] Coding standards and JSDoc are followed where applicable.
- [ ] Architecture, module boundaries and dependency direction are preserved.
- [ ] Public API and compatibility impact are reviewed.
- [ ] Security, trust boundaries and resource ownership are reviewed.
- [ ] Applicable behavioral, negative-path, boundary, determinism, isolation, security and architecture checks are completed.
- [ ] Regression tests and documentation are updated where applicable.
- [ ] Actual verification results and limitations are reported.
- [ ] No credentials, private content or generated builds are included.
- [ ] Applicable licensing and attribution are preserved.

See the [documentation index](../docs/README.md) and [definition of done](../tests/README.md#definition-of-done). Explain any inapplicable checklist items.
